review_prompt.authority: Perform a fresh, read-only scientific design audit in /home/u24/papers/mcrl-leo-handover. The two primary targets are proposals with no runtime, reward, preregistration, checkpoint, or training authority. Preserve the existing checkpoint as legacy-narrow sensitivity evidence. Make no edits, run no training, and inspect no Catfish treatment outcomes when judging physical parameters.
review_prompt.goal: Decide whether the geometry and R2 physical-provenance records are source faithful, mathematically correct, internally consistent, and sufficiently bounded to advance to implementation planning. The research objective prefers two new R2/R3 Catfish roles, but the audit must reject or narrow either role if the evidence does not support it.
review_prompt.success: Audit all issues rather than filtering by severity. In particular: 1. Verify the literal HOBS theta_3dB interpretation, full/half conversion, Bessel half-power calculation, footprint/lattice implications, and whether G0=500 is a defensible primary proposal rather than an overclaimed source value. 2. Verify ETSI TS 138 133 V18.13.0 meanings of 62/72 ms and 142/152 ms, electronic/mechanical applicability, phi1/phi2/re-entry mapping limits, absence or presence of a sourced E_HO, and all 30.08 s versus 0.640 s arithmetic. 3. Check both records against the Catfish design-data gate: outcome blindness, claim ceiling, source/derivation/recommendation separation, legacy checkpoint classification, state/horizon requirements, and the conditional R3 path. 4. Identify the smallest next safe action after the audit. Do not treat a green document review as evidence that either Catfish is effective.
review_prompt.verification: Before issuing the verdict, re-open the exact source or file lines supporting each blocker and major issue, and verify the target SHA-256 values. If a source is unavailable or ambiguous, classify the claim as unknown rather than filling the value.
review_prompt.output: Return a concise audit with exactly these sections: Verdict, Blockers, Majors, Minors, Verified facts, Remaining unknowns, Smallest next safe action. Verdict must be one of PASS_TO_IMPLEMENTATION_PLANNING, REVISE_BEFORE_PLANNING, or STOP_PHYSICAL_PATH. Cite repository evidence as file:line and primary-source evidence by document version plus clause/table/equation. Do not include private reasoning.
review_prompt.task: Read the listed documents first, then perform the bounded audit now. When you have enough information to act, act.
